summary.text: Bruce Euans is the Republican nominee for Ohio House District 9 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Munira Abdullahi.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as administrator.

paragraphs.text: Euans said in a Ballotpedia survey that he was born and raised in District 9, attended Columbus Northland High School and Ohio State University, and later earned special licensure from the Hondros College of Business.
He described his background as design/build, real estate, retail and business management in the private sector.
He listed three campaign messages: support for law enforcement, support for active-duty military, veterans and their families, and efforts against fraud, waste and abuse in government spending.
